mapper.select: select distinct s.id from kb_space s where s.space_status = 'ACTIVE' and ( s.owner_id = #{userId} or exists ( select 1 from kb_space_acl a where a.space_id = s.id and ( (a.subject_type = 'USER' and a.subject_id = #{userId}) or (a.subject_type = 'ROLE' and a.subject_id in ( select ur.role_id from sys_user_role ur where ur.user_id = #{userId})) or (a.subject_type = 'DEPT' and a.subject_id in ( select d.dept_id from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, d.ancestors))) ) ) )

select id, space_id, document_name, stable_key, document_version, is_current, file_path, file_size, mime_type, checksum_sha256, rag_document_id, parse_status, chunk_count, token_count, error_message, uploaded_by, ready_time, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, version from kb_document where parse_status = 'READY' and is_current = 1 and rag_document_id is not null and space_id in
#{spaceId}

select id, document_id, business_type, business_id, relation_type, create_by, create_time from kb_object_link where document_id in
#{documentId}

select count(1) from kb_space s where s.id = #{spaceId} and ( s.owner_id = #{userId} or exists ( select 1 from kb_space_acl a where a.space_id = s.id and a.permission_level = 'MANAGE' and ( (a.subject_type = 'USER' and a.subject_id = #{userId}) or (a.subject_type = 'ROLE' and a.subject_id in ( select ur.role_id from sys_user_role ur where ur.user_id = #{userId})) or (a.subject_type = 'DEPT' and a.subject_id in ( select d.dept_id from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, d.ancestors))) ) ) )
